strings.setting.Screen Mode.name: Screen Mode
strings.setting.Window Resolution.name: Window Resolution
strings.setting.Window Resolution.desc: Change your window resolution. (ONLY APPLIED IF ON WINDOWED!)
strings.setting.Master Volume.name: Master Volume
strings.setting.Master Volume.desc: Changes the game's main volume (affects everything).
strings.setting.Instrumental Volume.name: Instrumental Volume
strings.setting.Instrumental Volume.desc: Changes the volume for in-game instrumentals.
strings.setting.Voices Volume.name: Voices Volume
strings.setting.Voices Volume.desc: Changes the volume for in-game vocals.
strings.setting.Music Volume.name: Music Volume
strings.setting.Music Volume.desc: Changes the volume for menu music.
strings.setting.SFX Volume.name: SFX Volume
strings.setting.SFX Volume.desc: Changes the volume for general sound effects.
strings.setting.Ranking Sound.name: Ranking Sound
strings.setting.Ranking Sound.desc: Plays a sound when getting a higher or lower rank while playing a track.
strings.setting.Mute Voices on Miss.name: Mute Voices on Miss
strings.setting.Mute Voices on Miss.desc: Toggles muting the vocals when you miss. Useful if you'd like to hear uninterrupted music.
strings.setting.Keybinds....name: Keybinds...
strings.setting.Note Offset.name: Note Offset
strings.setting.Note Offset.desc: Changes the delay of the notes. Negative: Early, Positive: Late
strings.setting.Calculate Offset....name: Calculate Offset...
strings.setting.Calculate Offset....desc: Calculate your offset by pressing in the beat.
strings.setting.Downscroll.name: Downscroll
strings.setting.Downscroll.desc: Places the judgement line at the bottom of the screen. Notes will descend into it.
strings.setting.Middlescroll.name: Middlescroll
strings.setting.Middlescroll.desc: Positions the judgement line at the middle of the screen, hiding opponent notes.
strings.setting.HUD Customization....name: HUD Customization...
strings.setting.Note Splashes.name: Note Splashes
strings.setting.Note Splashes.desc: Toggles the visibility of the note splashes.
strings.setting.Hold Note Splashes.name: Hold Note Splashes
strings.setting.Hold Note Splashes.desc: Toggles the visibility of the hold note splashes.
strings.setting.Lane Background Visibility.name: Lane Background Visibility
strings.setting.Lane Background Visibility.desc: Adds a lane behind your strumlines.
strings.setting.Ghost Tapping.name: Ghost Tapping
strings.setting.Ghost Tapping.desc: Allows tapping freely when there are no notes.
strings.setting.Mechanics.name: Mechanics
strings.setting.Modchart.name: Modchart
strings.setting.Language.name: Language
strings.setting.Healthbar Visibility.name: Healthbar Visibility
strings.setting.Healthbar Visibility.desc: Toggles whether the health bar should be visible or not.
strings.setting.Show Accuracy.name: Show Accuracy
strings.setting.Show Accuracy.desc: Toggles accuracy stat on the in-game HUD.
strings.setting.Stats Position.name: Stats Position
strings.setting.Stats Position.desc: Changes the position of your stats HUD (misses, score, etc).
strings.setting.Icons.name: Icons
strings.setting.Icons.desc: Changes where the character icons will appear.
strings.setting.Show FPS.name: Show FPS
strings.setting.FPS Cap.name: FPS Cap
strings.setting.FPS Cap.desc: The maximum amount your framerate can reach.
strings.setting.Shaders.name: Shaders
strings.setting.Shaders.desc: Toggles shaders (may affect performance on low-end devices).
strings.setting.Flashing Lights.name: Flashing Lights
strings.setting.Flashing Lights.desc: Toggles flashing effects. Recommended to turn OFF in case of high photosensitivity.
strings.setting.Colorblind Filters.name: Colorblind Filters
strings.setting.Auto-Updates.name: Auto-Updates
strings.setting.Auto-Updates.desc: When an update is released, select whether to automatically download it, redirect you to a browser or do nothing.
strings.setting.Experimental Features.name: Experimental Features
strings.setting.Experimental Features.desc: Toggles features that are in a experimental phase. (SOME OF THEM MAY CRASH YOUR GAME!)
strings.setting.Modding Tools.name: Modding Tools
strings.setting.Modding Tools.desc: Enable tools for modding (such as the chart and character editors).
strings.setting.Moon Engine Version.name: Moon Engine Version
strings.setting.Moon Engine Version.desc: Moon Engine's current version. Thanks for using!
